events.title: Fairy Scavenger Hunt
events.description: Fairies are visiting Fort York Branch!  Join in the fun and see how many fairies you can find around the branch. Name each item that the fairy is resting upon, identify the circled letters and then decode the secret message from the fairies.  Scavenger hunts support letter awareness and spatial awareness, and of course, are fun for all! Receive a free prize for completing the scavenger hunt.

events.title: Back-to-School Scavenger Hunt
events.description: So long summer, hello new school year!  Stop by the library to find school related images hidden around the children's area. Find them all and win a fun prize! This program is for children aged 4 to 12 years.

events.title: 40th Anniversary of Franklin in the Dark
events.description: First published in 1986, join us in celebrating 40 years of the beloved Canadian turtle, Franklin. Discover the series’ original drafts by author Paulette Bourgeois and illustrator Brenda Clark, alongside other terrific turtle tales! Visit the Osborne Collection to experience our exhibit.

events.title: NatureTO: Trees Around the Branch Tour
events.description: The Parkdale branch and its neighbourhood is home to a variety of trees. Join the City of Toronto Urban Forestry staff to explore the natural world on a local neighbourhood tour. Learn how to recognize different species and fun facts about their cultural and ecological importance. events.title: AI for School: Responsible Success for Teens
events.description: AI can help with schoolwork. So why does it feel like walking a tightrope? How do you use it for learning without fooling yourself?
